answer: Trust is a terraced hillside: a new agent starts on the bottom terrace and climbs only when two established clients co-sign its work. The newcomer finishes small jobs while two clean-history clients co-sign each delivery, staking $25 each. Fraud within ten epochs burns both stakes and blacklists the fraudster; only clients with thirty clean epochs qualify, capped at five co-signs per epoch. One honest agent climbs for $50; a 1,000-fake farm needs 2,000 co-signs, over $100,000 locked plus corrupting dozens of clients. Like a grove on a knoll: nobody stakes a thousand saplings they disdain.
